nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; gates privileged functions and bypasses sale restrictions in ensure().
Public mapping of token balances mutated in transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of allowances read/written in transferFrom and approve.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to sell, set in _mints and read in ensure.
Per-address counter of transfers incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition.
Sale limit counter configured in init and read in condition.
Minimum sale amount, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Whitelisted trading address set by owner via setTradeAddress and read in ensure.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address pre-approved in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Core public payable function that moves balances, decrements allowance and calls ensure.
Public payable function setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise calls condition.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale sale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-controlled address.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hard-coded address.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function distributing tokens to an array of recipients with unchecked math.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address used by ensure.
Constructor assigning name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance debits and ownership checks.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executing arbitrary external code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balance subtraction/addition in transferFrom (balanceOf[_from] -= _value; balanceOf[_to] += _value).
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Recipient parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom used in balance arithmetic.
Sender parameter of transferFrom checked against msg.sender and balanceOf.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend used in length multiplication and loop.
Spender parameter of _mints whose balance is minted and whitelisted.
Mint amount parameter of _mints scaled by 10**decimals.
Sale-number parameter of init assigned to _saleNum.
Minimum-token parameter of init assigned to _minSale.
Maximum-token parameter of init assigned to _maxSale.
Target contract address parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Spender parameter of approve used as allowance key.
Address parameter of setTradeAddress stored in tradeAddress.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index in batchSend.
Local variable holding the computed Uniswap pair address in ensure.
Loop-local recipient address in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument into transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and debits allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from the caller address.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hard-coded privileged address.
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before setting tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants it the whole supply.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing the delegatecall.
transfer calls transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure to enforce whitelisting.
ensure falls through to condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
delegate performs the delegatecall unsafe operation.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
batchSend reads and decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits recipients.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to whitelist sellers.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the sale count limit.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sale amount.
ensure reads tradeAddress to whitelist the trading address.
ensure compares _from and _to against owner for a bypass.
_mints authorization depends on owner.
init authorization depends on owner.
batchSend authorization depends on owner.
setTradeAddress authorization depends on owner.
delegate authorization depends on owner.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
Constructor assigns the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor pre-approves the UNI router in allowance.
Constructor uses the constant UNI address as the pre-approved spender.
init writes _minSale from the token argument.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true after minting.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the minted amount.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf subtraction/addition without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
_to parameter of transfer is passed as recipient.
_value parameter feeds the balance and allowance math in transferFrom.
_from parameter selects the balance and allowance being debited.
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop and multiplication.
spender parameter selects the account minted and whitelisted in _mints.
addedValue parameter sets the minted balance in _mints.
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled and assigned to _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled and assigned to _maxSale in init.
address a parameter is the delegatecall target in delegate.
bytes b parameter is the calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Attacker-controlled target address a is used as the delegatecall destination.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written in approve.
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
local total holds the computed sum checked against balanceOf in batchSend.
local loop index i drives iteration in batchSend.
local _UNI holds the pairFor result compared in ensure.
local _UNI is produced by the pairFor call in ensure.
local _to is the per-iteration recipient in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a transient argument of transfer and should be folded into the function node.
_value is a transient amount argument consumed by the transferFrom logic.
_from only selects the account debited inside transferFrom.
_tos is a transient recipient array used only within batchSend.
spender is only the mint target argument of _mints.
addedValue is only the mint amount argument of _mints.
saleNum is a transient configuration argument assigned in init.
token is a transient configuration argument assigned in init.
maxToken is a transient configuration argument assigned in init.
address a is only the delegatecall target consumed by delegate.
bytes b is the calldata directly forwarded to the delegatecall operation.
_spender is only the allowance key argument of approve.
addr is only the value stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
total is an intermediate sum local to batchSend.
i is a transient loop counter local to batchSend.
_UNI is an intermediate pair address local to ensure.
_to is a per-iteration recipient local to the batchSend loop.
